lead.description: estimates of a polynomial mean obtained by minimising squared residuals

self_checks.title: Four-point quadratic
self_checks.prompt: For (0, 1), (1, 2), (2, 2) and (3, 5), what are the quadratic coefficients and the residual sum of squares?
self_checks.answer: The coefficients are 1.2, −0.3 and 0.5. The residual sum of squares is 0.8.

self_checks.title: Straight line on the same points
self_checks.prompt: What is the residual sum of squares of the straight line fitted to those four points?
self_checks.answer: The residual sum of squares is 1.8.

self_checks.title: Three-point parabola
self_checks.prompt: What is the residual sum of squares when y = β0 + β1 x + β2 x^2 is fitted to (0, 1), (1, 0) and (2, 1)?
self_checks.answer: The residual sum of squares is 0.
